阿妲·托尔德朵蒂.who: 人族，长船诸部的女子，守冬营外头那一片黑水。约1318年寒星月她握着冒白气的舵一夜撞了十一回，冬营的人叫她黑水之舵，约1350年走到了传奇。名字留在长船舵柄上刻的那一道黑上。

at.text: 约1318年寒星月，西陆北岸峡湾的四十条船压过冰海来劫冬营，阿妲砍开自家长船两边的冰冲进船队，一夜撞了十一回。往后她照旧出海换鱼，撞断的桨一支一支还给各家。约1396年她在一处冰口头一回碰上阿鲁赫，两条船船头对着船头，谁也没撞谁。

quotes: 船尾留给我。你们往前划，朝那道黑水去。
阿妲·托尔德朵蒂.note: 纷争纪时段_四 第3686到3723行凡世至强黑水之舵（凝名纪年、凝名伟业、往后的事、声口台词样例），补卷_07 第474行。at 写到1440年那一撞以前。

拉扎尔·浮网.who: 人族，盐海北岸红晶滩的网户。1146年联军头一回往礁上拉铁链，他把链头缠在手上，链环从掌心穿过，礁缝合上他也没松手，营垒上的兵叫他链不脱手。名字留在红滩链头一节上，补灯的人路过都拍一下。

at.text: 1146年链头上的温菲丽德倒下，伊璐涅攥住链子往礁底下沉，拉扎尔把链子往右手上一绕，链环从掌心穿过去，把她拖进了合拢的礁缝，链子拉到了礁上。往后链子往外接长，他照旧头一个下水摸旧礁缝，滩上的人谢他，他摆手。
他照旧在红晶滩的礁上，链船靠岸、补网、接链都在。红滩链上挂满了灯，盐垒的守灯人补灯以前先拍一下头一节。2611年霜降月钟夜，他跟着帕克图南去，守在河谷口。

quotes: 往北走。等你们过完了，我再松。
拉扎尔·浮网.note: 纷争纪时段_四 第3647到3684行凡世至强链不脱手，补卷_06 第247、253行，补卷_68 钟夜第66行。at 12 写到河谷口守着为止。

琳琪.who: 兽耳，风啸牧带的狼耳弓手。约1240年她在悬羽崖上拉了一夜弓，一箭从二百丈的崖顶射穿领头的有名者，牧带的人叫她崖顶之弓，约1280年走到了传奇。名字留在那一张弓背上，拿弓的人都描一遍。

at.text: 约1240年牧带上传说有名者领人朝牧场来，琳琪在悬羽崖上拉了一夜弓，最后一箭射穿领头那人，后头几百个人掉头往东去了。后来她才知道射中的是领着族人往东找一块不必献血的地的芬妮娅，她把这个名字刻进了弓背。
她照旧在风啸南缘的牧带上，不打仗的时候替牧人接羊羔，真来抢人的队伍她照拦，崖下走路的人她也下去问一句往哪里去。后来她下山上墙，2104年寒星月高灯之冬，跟着南去，守莉薇兰帐前那一面朝北的黑石坡。

quotes: 让我看清。你背上那包会动。
琳琪.note: 纷争纪时段_四 第3725到3762行凡世至强崖顶之弓，补卷_07 第197行，补卷_68 高灯之冬第19行。源稿只写她后来才知道射中的是芬妮娅，没写哪一年知道的，放在第11张那一段。

萨珂.who: 魔族白骸，三营四百零八号。约1056年秋汛，她顺着生角的人插下的沼路标摸着烂桩走了四十夜，领白骸三个营出了毒沼，三个营叫她沼中之标。长垒这一边只叫她走沼的那一位，白骸的车夫过沼以前照旧报她的编号。

at.text: 约1056年秋汛，萨珂领着困在毒沼心的三个营走了四十夜，每摸到一根桩先把自己的编号往后报一遍，三拨人都上了鸦岭西坡。往后一百来年白骸往南边送骨料的车走她踩出来的这一条路，车过沼以前先报一声三营四百零八号。
她后来跟着大伙往南去，守在南边魔族的营座前。2104年寒星月高灯之冬，营座前连泥地都映着北边的灯，她领着人往灯底下冲，每退一段把脚下的软地压硬，好让伤兵躺在抬得走的车上。

quotes: 后面的，你应一声。我等你。
三营四百零八号，萨珂。你没有编号？那就报名字。
萨珂.note: 纷争纪时段_四 第3764到3801行凡世至强沼中之标，补卷_08 第88行，补卷_68 高灯之冬第19行。at 12 写到第七回以前。

阿鲁赫.who: 魔族深潮，西陆北岸峡湾的船家，晕船也不肯下船头。约1395年冬他在湾口念了一夜，十二面帆迎着北风倒鼓，十二条船顶着风出了湾，船家叫他逆风之帆。长垒这一边只叫他倒挂帆的那一位。

at.text: 约1395年冬阿鲁赫唱着帆把十二条船带出峡湾。约1396年他在冰海一处冰口头一回碰上长船的阿妲，两条船叫同一场风卡了好几天。约1440年他在雾里拿反帆冲出来，撞断了阿妲的舵，自己在断梁上割掉半张主帆才没跟着沉。
他照旧带着船出湾去截长船的货，也把叫冰困住的同族船家接回来，那半张湿帆挂在船棚里。约1702年冬寒潮早来一个月，海一夜冻上，他的船叫封在冰海当中，他把船上的人一个一个赶下甲板，叫他们踩着冰走回峡湾。

阿鲁赫.note: 纷争纪时段_四 第3803到3840行凡世至强逆风之帆，补卷_07 第474行，补卷_74 第15行。at 12 写到他把人赶下船为止。

刻玛·赤脊.who: 魔族炎角赤脊氏。约2410年她冲到长垒南段第六段墙下，三门龙雷炮各打了她一炮，她从雷里走出来，角上的火窜起一丈高，赤脊氏的人叫她灼雷。长垒这一边只叫她吃了三炮的那一位。

at.text: 约2410年刻玛吃了三炮，一直冲到第二道垛口底下才退，回去拿烙锥把左臂上的三道疤描齐。誓尽以前她跟戈缪在南崖上分过一块烤肉。2996年坠叶月誓尽第八夜，她把火吸进两只角里倒成一面赤帘，跟谷底阿丝特丽的霜顶到天亮。

quotes: 这道？南六段最左边那门。你以为我只记得疼？
刻玛·赤脊.note: 纷争纪时段_四 第3959到3996行凡世至强灼雷，第107行时段总纲龙雷炮一段，补卷_68 誓尽第102、109、110行。at 写到第九天天亮以前。

奥菲涅·秋弦.who: 精灵，翠冠的秋弦家。约2655年坠叶月她在南九段一座烽塔顶上射了一千三百箭，把扑到塔尖的影子钉在墙前，南九段的兵叫她落影之羽，约2695年走到了传奇。名字刻在南九段段门的门框上。

at.text: 约2655年奥菲涅在烽塔顶上射了一夜，天亮时墙前插满了箭。往后她在南九段又守了几十年，给妹妹莱希缇回信总说明年。约2720年花信月长息，她跟阿丝特丽守石原西头，十九天里射出去的箭在崖下插成一片林子。

quotes: 把弓留稳。她会来拿，不认得路也会来。
奥菲涅·秋弦.note: 纷争纪时段_四 第3920到3957行凡世至强落影之羽，补卷_68 长息第81、86、90行。at 写到第十九天以前。

希瑟娅.who: 魔族，有翼的，往后这一支叫夜翼。她的翼比同族宽一半，在云上只叫不扑，一叫，几千对翼一齐转向，传奇之名一声千翼。墙这一边的战报只记有名者在场、有翼。

at.text: 约2400年坠叶月，一股魔潮压上长垒南段，希瑟娅领着前头几千有翼的魔族专扑天上替炮看落点的狮鹫。她在最密的那一团上头，不扑，只叫，九天里白鸢一百二十头狮鹫只剩七头能飞，墙上的炮一发一发落空。

希瑟娅.note: 没有自己的条目。纷争纪时段_四 第756、787、792、794行，第3337、3377行，补卷_09 白鸢的天第70到79行，补卷_83 第42行。凝名的年份页上不给，who 不写。

戈缪.who: 魔族，有翼的，往后叫夜翼，左翼断过长歪了，只能往左拐。约2846年他领着有翼的一夜扑了三回，墙前落了三十七头狮鹫，有翼的人叫他落鹫。长垒这一边只叫他扑鞍的那一位。

at.text: 约2846年戈缪三回扑下去，南段的炮瞎了十来天。下雨飞不了的日子他替同伴补鞍扣，每补一个在扣背上刻一道细痕。誓尽以前他跟刻玛在南崖上分过一块烤肉，2996年坠叶月誓尽，他守在南崖上。

quotes: 歪就是歪嘛。你又不是今天才看见。
戈缪.note: 纷争纪时段_四 第3998到4035行凡世至强落鹫，第107行，补卷_68 誓尽第102、108行。at 写到第五天以前。

杜凡·冬栅.who: 人族，化圣雪原南缘那一圈石屋出来的人。约2676年寒星月他一口一口呵出一道一丈高的冰墙，三支巡冰队一百四十个人在墙后熬了九天，巡冰队叫他呵冰。名字刻在南九段段门的门框上。

at.text: 约2676年白毛风里，一百四十个人顺着杜凡呵出来的冰墙走回长垒。往后他守巡冰队回墙的那一条路，约2705年走到了传奇。约2720年花信月长息，他一个人守石原东头，一跺脚从地里长出一排三丈高、十几里长的冰栅。

杜凡·冬栅.note: 纷争纪时段_四 第3881到3918行凡世至强呵冰，补卷_68 长息第81、86、88、90行。at 写到布涅到的那一天以前。

纳尔萨.who: 魔族深潮，耳后张着一对银鳍。约2440年冬他领着深潮的船从冰海绕到潮歌的岛群，雾贴着船走，一个冬天扑了九座外岛，灯塔一座也没拆，船家叫他雾里的鳍。长垒这一边只叫他雾里来的那一位。

at.text: 约2440年冬纳尔萨劫了潮歌九座外岛。往后他领着一支深潮的船队在潮歌的岛群一带劫粮劫人，叫人把九座岛的灯塔画下来，照着挑下一回靠岸的地方。约2510年他回到灯脊岛外头，拿雾扣住港里要离港的船。

纳尔萨.note: 纷争纪时段_四 第4115到4152行凡世至强雾里的鳍，补卷_07 第432行，纷争纪时段_七 第1566行约恩。at 写到约恩进港以前。

阿丝特丽·霜桨.who: 人族，北境人，拄一柄包铁长桨。2694年炎潮月墙连着三百个兵歪进熔流，她跳下去一桨冻住一丈，两夜把那一块墙撑了回来，那三百个兵叫她熔河上的桨。名字刻在南九段门框上，挨着杜凡和奥菲涅。

at.text: 2694年阿丝特丽撑回了那一块墙。约2720年长息她守石原西头，把山口冻成一面冰崖，回来的只有她，杜凡和奥菲涅的名字她刻在了南九段的门框上。2996年坠叶月誓尽第八夜，她拄着桨下到谷底，三十里烂泥冻成一条白路。

quotes: 桨给我。站稳了，别往下看。
阿丝特丽·霜桨.note: 纷争纪时段_四 第3842到3879行凡世至强熔河上的桨，补卷_68 长息第81、86、90行，誓尽第102、109行。at 写到第八夜下谷为止。

屈内贡德·断崖.who: 矮人，断崖一支的矿匠。约2236年墙那一边一个营挖穿了水轮矿的矿井，她把铁锤抵在水轮的轴心上一扳，三百丈高的瀑布倒着流了半天，矿工叫她扳瀑。名字留在瀑布底下石头上刻的那一把锤上。

at.text: 约2236年屈内贡德扳回瀑布，又叫它一头扎进井口，井里的营没有上到井场。往后她另装了新辐，挖来的黑洞她带着人一段一段填死了。后来她替南段的炮组修台基，龙雷炮一炮一震，她听台基里哪一道石纹在走。
约3220年秋，死域北沿新筑的十二座魔晶炮台排成一线，屈内贡德守最东头第十二座的台基，德赫恩那一门龙雷炮就架在这一座上。轰狱的瓦戈隆一夜从西往东推，前十一座一座一座翻进了草里。

屈内贡德·断崖.note: 纷争纪时段_四 第4076到4113行凡世至强扳瀑，第107行，补卷_31 第163行。at 13 写到她上前以前。

德赫恩·琥鳞.who: 龙裔，天脊琥鳞一支的炮手。约2470年冬他把一门龙雷炮推到天脊山口当中，一夜打了十一炮，翻山来的营没有过去，琥鳞的人叫他血尽之膛。名字留在山口石缝里那一截炮口上。

at.text: 约2470年冬德赫恩守住了天脊山口，往后在南段的龙雷炮阵上领射。2996年坠叶月誓尽，他在北崖上专打南崖的有名者，第五天一炮打断了戈缪的翼根，第九天天亮一炮撞穿了刻玛的角根，余雷往南铺出去几百里。
约3220年秋，死域北沿新筑的十二座魔晶炮台排成一线，德赫恩那一门龙雷炮架在最东头的第十二座上，屈内贡德守着那一座的台基。轰狱的瓦戈隆一夜从西往东推炮台，一座一座往草里倒。

quotes: 这一颗我自己送。你们退到石坎后头，听完了再出来。
德赫恩·琥鳞.note: 纷争纪时段_四 第4037到4074行凡世至强血尽之膛，第107行，补卷_07 第285行，补卷_68 誓尽第102、108、110行。誓尽那一炮他到了更高一档，档位字不写。

falls.how: 约1440年两边在雾里又碰上，阿鲁赫的帆迎着风鼓起来，从本该让开的水上倒撞回来，撞断了阿妲的舵轴。她抱住断舵，把身上的热一股一股送进冰里，熔出一道黑水的弯，给后头十几条长船让出逃路，热送到尽，她抱着断舵跟船一起翻进了海里。
falls.name: 抱舵
falls.light: cold grey fog over a frozen sea at first light, the only warmth a pale orange glow of heat and white steam rising from the woman and the broken tiller in her arms
falls.camera: low at the waterline off the stern quarter, looking up at her across the black melted channel, tilted slightly toward the fog
falls.text: Scene: first light on a frozen northern sea in thick grey fog, the ice cracking and groaning. Filling the upper left of the frame and cut off by the edge, the high prow of an enemy ship looms out of the fog, its sail bulging the wrong way, swollen toward the wind while the snow streams past it in the other direction. In the near foreground, on the tilted stern of a battered northern longship, stands the woman of the black water, seen at three-quarter from the side, facing left toward the looming prow. She is tall and broad-shouldered, about twenty-eight, her red-brown hair in three long braids whipping in the wind, blue-grey eyes narrowed, a faint old scar across the bridge of her nose, small bone pendants at her ears, a heavy fur cloak knotted at her waist, her strong bare arms wrapped around a snapped wooden tiller, its shaft studded with three copper nails. Her forearms are raw red from cold, her jaw set hard. Clouds of white steam pour off her body and the broken tiller and drop onto the ice below, where a wide curving channel of black open water is melting away from the hull in a long bend. Behind her on the right, small in the fog, a dozen longships with striped sails are turning one after another into that black curve and rowing away from us toward a faint glow of shore fires. Loose ice shards, steam and blowing snow drift large and out of focus across the corners.
falls.note: 纷争纪时段_四 第3698行：她抱住断舵把热送进冰里，熔出黑水的弯，后头长船顺着让开。画的是热还在往冰里送的那一下，对面阿鲁赫那条船只露船头和反鼓的帆。源稿没写她身上的伤，只写冻红的手臂。

falls.where: 钟夜那一道河谷的谷口
falls.how: 钟夜最后那一夜，神战震断了谷口上头的山梁，一里多长的山脊朝撤路倒下来。拉扎尔把铁链甩过两座峰根扣死，把整道山梁停在撤下来的人头顶，拽到最后一队出了谷口，才把身子往没人的侧谷一拧，链子一节接一节炸开，山梁把他连着断链压进了谷底。
falls.name: 悬山
falls.light: night lit from above by a glowing red-gold chain and burning trees falling through the dark, a cold white glare of a god's battle far up the valley
falls.camera: low worm's-eye angle from the escape road beneath the hanging ridge, tilted, the old man small at the lower right bracing against the chain
falls.text: Scene: the last night of a great battle of gods in a deep river valley, the sky black, the air full of smoke. Across the whole upper half of the frame a broken mountain ridge more than half a mile long hangs in the air a dozen fathoms above the road, cut off by the top edge, its underside raw rock and torn roots, held by a single enormous iron chain that glows red-gold link by link and is hooked around two rocky peak-roots on either side. Uprooted pine trees slide off the ridge and fall onto the burning chain, catching fire one after another, a rain of flaming branches. Far up the valley behind, in a white glare, the towering shape of an immense old god with an empty scabbard at his hip stands half lost in smoke. On the lower right, near the foreground, a broad-backed old fisherman of the salt coast braces with both feet on the rocks, leaning far back against the chain wrapped around his right hand and forearm, seen from the side and facing left toward the valley mouth: about fifty to look at, very tall, grey hair cropped close, a white-streaked beard, a wind-reddened nose, deep-set eyes, a sea-stained wool coat. Light shines through a hole in the middle of his right palm where the chain passes. His arms are torn and bleeding where the links have bitten in, his teeth clenched in something like a grin. On the left, small, the last column of soldiers and wounded on stretchers hurries out of the valley mouth away from us. Burning needles, sparks and ash drift large and blurred across the corners.
falls.note: 纷争纪时段_四 第3659行，补卷_68 钟夜第66行。画的是山梁停在头顶、最后一队往谷口走的那一下。帕克图只画成远处谷里一个高大的影子，祂那一夜做了什么不画。掌心的洞照仪容那一行。

falls.where: 南界以南，朝北的黑石坡
falls.how: 萨珂领着南边的人马往灯底下冲了七回，第七回坡前的箭射空了，琳琪把留在黑石里的旧箭一齐叫响，把冲上来的旗和盾掀过了高灯的顶。最后半支箭放出去，倒卷回来的风要穿她自己的胸背，她一侧身风就扑进撤下来的人里，她没有侧身，拿脊背接住了它。
falls.name: 回卷风
falls.light: deep winter night, hundreds of white-gold lamps hanging high on the slope behind her, the wind itself a pale white glow rolling down the black stone
falls.camera: behind and slightly above her right shoulder on the slope, looking down the long black hill into the oncoming host, tilted steeply
falls.text: Scene: a bitter winter night on a long north-facing slope of black stone south of the frontier. Behind and above, out of frame at the top, hang tall poles of white-gold lamps lighting the hilltop. Down the slope the ground is split into glowing cracks, and a huge rolling surf of pale white wind tears down the hill, lifting banners and shields high into the air above the lamps. At the foot of the slope, filling the lower edge and cut off by the frame, a dark host of horned warriors pushes up a road that rises like a raised ridge of white bone. In the near foreground on the upper right stands the cliff-top archer, a slender wolf-eared woman about twenty-five, seen from behind at three-quarter, facing away from us down the slope: tall and long-legged, a thin strong back, deep grey wolf ears rimmed with silver, chestnut hair tied short at the nape, her tail pressed flat to one side against the wind, a plain herder's coat and leather bracers. She holds a long hardwood bow at full draw with half an arrow on the string, carved marks along the back of the bow, her left ear turned forward toward the target and her right ear back toward the people retreating behind her. Her quiver is empty. Blood soaks one sleeve where a stray shard has cut her shoulder, and her shoulders are squared, not turning aside. Small on the left, a line of wounded soldiers stumbles back up toward the lamps. Grit, splinters of arrows and white wind-streaks blur across the corners.
falls.note: 纷争纪时段_四 第3737行，补卷_68 高灯之冬第19行。画的是最后半支箭放出去以前那一下，她不侧身。肩上的伤是照打过的仗补的，源稿没写。

falls.where: 南界以南，黑石坡下的营座前
falls.how: 第七回琳琪的箭把北坡劈成一面白的风墙，萨珂把两只脚沉进黑泥里，硬路从她膝前翻起来，几里长的车道像一条举起来的白骨脊往坡上拱。她一挪脚硬路就散，路上驮着退下来的人，她没有挪，等最后一声应完，倒卷回来的风夹着断箭和碎石穿过了她的胸口。
falls.name: 白骨脊
falls.light: winter night, the bone-white road glowing faintly from within, a wall of white wind on the slope above reflecting the far lamps on the hilltop
falls.camera: low from the mud beside her, looking up along the rising white ridge toward the slope, strongly tilted
falls.text: Scene: a winter night at the foot of a black stone slope south of the frontier, the ground churned into black mud. A road of hard white crust rises out of the mud in front of a woman and climbs the slope for miles like an enormous lifted spine of white bone, cut off by the top of the frame where a vertical wall of white wind howls down from the hill. On the bone ridge, small, carts and stretchers of wounded horned soldiers slide back down toward the left out of the wind's path. In the near foreground on the right stands the marsh guide of the White Bone clans, seen from the side, facing the slope on the left: a tall long-boned woman who looks about twenty-five, ash-white skin, two pale natural bone-ridges along both sides of her neck, grey hair cut at the jaw, dark green eyes, a plain grey wrap and leather gear spattered with mud, a black ring of mud stain around each ankle. Both her feet are sunk deep into the black mud and the white crust climbs up from around her knees. Her mouth is open as she calls back a number down the line, one hand raised to signal the carts, her face calm. Gusts of wind carrying broken arrows and stones already tear across the ridge toward her, and blood runs from cuts on her cheek and arm. Behind her on the far right, low banners of a war camp. Mud spray, broken arrow shafts and bone dust blur across the corners.
falls.note: 纷争纪时段_四 第3776行，补卷_68 高灯之冬第19行。画的是她不挪脚、还在叫最后一声的那一下，风刚扑到。白骸的角源稿没写，没画。

falls.how: 北风把冰拱起来，回峡湾的路眼看要折成一道一道沟。阿鲁赫站回船头，反帆鼓满，把方圆十几里的浮冰挤成一道朝岸边去的长梁，桅杆断了，帆索缠住了船头，也缠住了他。他一停唱冰梁就折，他一直唱到最后一队人上了岸，唱声才断。
falls.name: 冰梁
falls.light: deep winter dusk, blue-black sky, the pale glow of the ice ridge and the white sail, faint warm fires of a fjord shore far away
falls.camera: from the frozen sea in front of the bow, looking up at the singer and the reversed sail, slight upward tilt
falls.text: Scene: deep winter dusk on a sea frozen solid overnight, a freezing north wind driving snow from left to right. Behind the ship, filling the upper half of the frame and cut off by the edges, a great white sail bellies out the wrong way, swollen toward the wind while the snow streams past it in the opposite direction; the mast below it is snapped and hangs aslant. In the foreground at the bow of the trapped ship stands the singer of the backward sail, seen from the front at three-quarter, facing right toward the shore: a tall deep-sea demon, very broad in the chest and narrow at the waist, a layer of fine blue-black fins along his shoulder blades, long slit gills on both sides of his neck, black hair combed back, dark gold eyes, a mouth that turns down a little at the corners, a heavy pale robe whose cuffs are washed whiter than the rest. Snapped rigging is wound around the bow and around his legs and waist. His mouth is open in a long held song, his lips blue with cold, frost crusted in his hair, blood frozen on his hands from the ropes. In front of him the drifting ice is heaped and squeezed into one long raised ridge that runs away to the right across the sea toward a dark shore, and along it, small and far off, a thin line of people walks away from us toward the faint fires of a fjord. Snow, ice dust and frayed rope ends blur across the corners.
falls.note: 纷争纪时段_四 第3815行，补卷_74 第15行。画的是他还在唱、冰梁上的人还在走的那一下。

falls.how: 誓尽第九天天亮，北崖上德赫恩那一门龙雷炮打过来，刻玛张开两只角去吞。那一炮里的雷比她吞过的都重，第四团雷撞穿了她的角根，胸口里攒了几百年的旧雷一齐倒涌上来，南崖上腾起一根火柱，从当中折断，她倒在崖沿上。
falls.name: 第四炮
falls.light: grey dawn over a gorge, a blinding crimson bolt crossing from the right, the woman's horns and arms blazing with orange fire
falls.camera: low on the cliff edge just behind her left side, looking past her across the gorge at the incoming bolt, hard tilt
falls.text: Scene: dawn over a deep gorge cut through a red-earth plateau, a frozen white road running along the mud of the gorge floor far below. On the far cliff beyond the gorge, in the upper right, a tiny row of cannons smokes, and from them a huge bolt of crimson lightning shaped like a dragon's breath comes over the gorge straight at the near cliff, so bright it bleaches the sky. In the near foreground, left of centre, at the very lip of the southern cliff, stands the horned woman who ate three cannon shots, seen in pure back view: we see the back of her head and her back, never her face, as she faces into the picture toward the bolt. She is clearly a woman: tall, long-legged, a woman's narrow waist and hips, short black-red hair. Two horns grow one above each temple and sweep straight back and a little outward, so both horns are seen at once from behind, one on each side of her head, glowing ember cracks at their roots. Her scorched armour leaves the upper back bare between the shoulder blades, and down the middle of her back runs a line of fine red scales along her spine. Both arms are thrown wide to the sides at shoulder height, hands open; she lowers her head, horns forward, to swallow the bolt, and fire roars off her horns and both arms. Her left arm is the one on the picture's left: three old burn scars on its upper arm have split open and her blood drips onto the red earth, where it hardens into black glass. Her right arm, on the picture's right, is unhurt. Her two legs are planted apart on the cliff edge. Behind her along the cliff top on the left, small, horned warriors with shields crouch away from the light. Sparks, flakes of glass and red dust blur over the corners.
falls.note: 纷争纪时段_四 第3971行，补卷_68 誓尽第110行。画的是雷撞上来、她张角去吞的那一下。源稿写她的角根吞得下低一档的雷、吞不下这一炮里高一档的雷，how 里档位字避开了。角写成往后直扫，不画成弯的。

falls.how: 第十九天奥菲涅的手指已经扣不住新箭，拿指根抵住弦，最后一箭朝东射过整片石原，钉在东头杜凡的冰栅上，嗡了半夜。布涅压到石原上，她那一口气跟几万人的一样卡在喉咙里，她靠着崖顶一块石头坐下，弓压在身子底下，没再起来。
falls.name: 过原箭
falls.light: pale cold spring evening, no wind, a silvery glow from a forest of arrows planted below the cliff, the far east of the plain hazed white
falls.camera: from beside her on the cliff top, close behind her drawing arm, looking east over the whole stone plain, slight tilt
falls.text: Scene: a still spring evening on a vast stone plain ringed by mountains, where no wind moves and no grass grows. Below the cliff, a whole forest of white arrows stands planted in the ground, faintly glowing, and the shafts are just beginning to swing around to face the same direction. Far across the plain, small and hazy, a long line of ice palisades glints at the eastern pass. At the right edge of the frame, cut off by the border, rises an enormous gaunt shape draped in a burial shroud at the edge of the plain, a cloud of white breath hanging unmoving at its mouth; across the plain below, thousands of soldiers lie still on the stones. In the near foreground on the cliff top stands the archer of falling shadows, an elf woman who looks barely twenty, seen in profile from the right, facing left and east across the plain: tall, long-armed and slight in the shoulders, a thin pale gold braid down her back, green eyes, pointed ears with a small dark wooden pendant, a scuffed green-and-grey archer's coat. She has just loosed her last arrow and holds the long bow still raised and trembling, the string pressed with the base of her fingers because her fingertips are split and bleeding. Her lips are parted and her throat is tight as if a breath is caught there, her face pale and exhausted but steady. A large flat stone stands just behind her. Floating dust, a few stray white feathers and frayed bowstring threads blur across the corners.
falls.note: 纷争纪时段_四 第3932行，补卷_68 长息第86行。画的是最后一箭刚离弦、她还站着的那一下，坐下以前。布涅照史诗战一阶的样子（殓布、嘴边一团白雾），只露画框边上一截。

falls.how: 希瑟娅叫了十一天，几千对翼靠那一声连成一片，她一走翼就散在炮口底下，她没有走，那一声一回比一回哑。第十一天天亮以前，白鸢最后七头狮鹫钻进最密的那一团找到了她，雷金一炮赤红龙雷落在她身上，她已经没有挡的力气。
falls.name: 哑声
falls.light: the first sun rising behind her through low cloud, turning her into a dark silhouette rimmed in gold, a crimson bolt climbing from far below
falls.camera: high in the sky below and behind the swarm, looking up into the sun past her wings, wide and tilted
falls.text: Scene: just after dawn high above a great white stone wall that runs from horizon to horizon far below, the sun breaking through low cloud. Thousands of winged warriors swirl in a dense dark flock filling the frame, wings beating, bone spears in their hands, the mass of them wheeling as one. In the middle of the flock, slightly above center, hovers their leader, a winged demon woman whose wings spread half again wider than any around her, dark and broad, the sunlight glowing through their edges. She is seen against the sun as a dark silhouette rimmed in gold, her face mostly lost in the glare, long hair streaming, her head thrown back and mouth wide open in a hoarse cry, her body thin and worn, her wings ragged and torn from eleven days in the air. She does not dive; she only calls. Far below on the left, small and dark against the cloud, seven griffins with riders and signal flags dive into the thickest part of the flock, one rider standing in the stirrups pointing up at her. From the wall far below on the right, a single bolt of crimson lightning rises straight up toward her through the swarm, the nearest wings scattering from its path. Tiny cannon flashes dot the wall. Loose dark feathers, torn wing membrane fragments and cloud vapor blur across the corners.
falls.note: 纷争纪时段_四 第756行，补卷_09 白鸢的天第76行。源稿没有她的样子，只写翼比别的宽一半，画成逆光的剪影。第十二张节点原画里已有“宽翼”，多半画的是同一拍（吉纳维芙看见那一对宽翼），这一幅改从下面仰看、雷正往上来，要不要并成一幅请主会话定。

falls.how: 誓尽第五天，戈缪顺着左翼把南崖上的有翼的带成一道横跨谷口的黑弧，再一个人从弧底下扎向北崖的龙雷炮。德赫恩不追他的身子，等在那一只只能往左拐的翅膀转回来的地方，赤雷撞穿了他的翼根，他拖着一条火尾砸进了谷底的烂泥里。
falls.name: 左旋
falls.light: overcast autumn day with low fog in the gorge, the muzzle flash of a cannon throwing crimson light up from the far cliff
falls.camera: midair close behind and below him as he banks, looking along his dive toward the far cliff, extreme roll tilt
falls.text: Scene: an overcast autumn day over a deep gorge of red earth, low fog lying in the bottom over black mud. High across the top of the frame, cut off by the edges, a dark arc of hundreds of winged warriors spans the gorge from the southern cliff. Below the arc, alone, the dark-winged man who strikes the saddles dives toward the northern cliff on the right, seen from behind and below at three-quarter, his body banking hard to the left: lean and long-limbed, wings spread more than twenty feet wide, dark brown membranes threaded with fine gold veins, the left wing visibly crooked at an old healed break and held lower than the right, short dark brown hair, olive eyes narrowed, a small mole on his left cheek, a leather pouch of saddle buckles at his waist and a short hooked blade in his right hand. His face is turned over his shoulder in a quick tight grin as he swings left. On the far cliff at the right edge, small, a single heavy rune-carved cannon flares, and a bolt of crimson lightning is already crossing the gorge toward the root of his crooked wing, exactly where his turn will carry him. Blood streaks his ribs from an earlier cut. Below in the fog, tiny lines of shields march along the gorge floor. Fog wisps, sparks and loose feathers blur across the corners.
falls.note: 纷争纪时段_四 第4010行，补卷_68 誓尽第108行。画的是他往左拐、雷已经朝弧尾打过来的那一下。肋下的伤是照打过的仗补的。

falls.where: 长息，石原东头的冰栅后
falls.how: 布涅到的那一天，石原上该走的那一口气一齐停住，杜凡倒在冰栅后头，那一口气卡在喉咙里，冰栅一根也没化，一个多月东头没有一支队伍过得来。到最后塞维娅接走了布涅那一口气，杜凡那一口也吐了出来，三丈高的冰栅一齐化成了水，顺着山口往北淌了一天。
falls.name: 冰栅
falls.light: cold grey spring daylight without wind, a thin pale blue line glowing along the crest of the ice palisade
falls.camera: low behind the man at the foot of the palisade, looking up past him at the ice and the shrouded giant beyond, slight tilt
falls.text: Scene: a windless grey spring day at the eastern pass of a stone plain ringed by mountains. A row of jagged ice palisades three fathoms high runs across the whole frame from left to right and away for miles, each stake grown out of the ground with outward-pointing spikes, enemy banners and shields frozen onto the spikes. Beyond the palisade, rising over it at the upper right and cut off by the frame, an immense gaunt shape draped in a burial shroud looms over the plain, a cloud of white breath hanging unmoving at its mouth. In the near foreground at the foot of the palisade stands the man who breathes ice, seen from behind at three-quarter, facing the ice and the shrouded giant: a broad-chested northern man about thirty-six, square shoulders, a short thick neck, black hair streaked with natural ash-grey, clean-shaven, pale blue eyes, old healed white cracks on his lips, an old wool coat, a grey-white scarf whose last row of knitting is mended in different yarn, worn fingerless wool gloves. His right foot has just stamped down and frost spreads out from it into the stone toward the ice. His mouth is pressed shut, his chest swollen with a held breath, his face strained and grey, blood from a split lip frozen on his chin. Behind him on the left, small, a camp of tents and a few soldiers sit waiting. Ice dust, frost crystals and still snowflakes hang large and blurred in the corners.
falls.note: 纷争纪时段_四 第3893行，补卷_68 长息第86行。画的是布涅压到石原上、他憋住那一口气还站着的那一下，倒下以前。挂魔神显像，照殓布和嘴边白雾写。

falls.where: 潮歌外岛，灯脊岛的礁下
falls.how: 破雾的归人约恩拿叉子朝雾里一划，雾从当中裂开，灯脊岛的灯照出礁来，纳尔萨的船队最前头那一条横着撞上了礁脊。他潜到船底下，拖着裂开的龙骨把船往外拧，船后头那一条逃路亮了一下，第二道雾墙跟着他划伤的鳍一起砸下来，把他和那条船一齐压向礁根。
falls.name: 灯脊礁
falls.light: night fog torn open by a white lighthouse beam slanting from the left, the water below lit green-grey where the beam enters
falls.camera: half-and-half split at the waterline, above the surface the wrecked ship and the fog wall, below it the swimmer under the keel, slight tilt
falls.text: Scene: night off a small rocky island, a split view at the waterline. Above the surface, a towering wall of white fog curls over the scene from the right like a breaking wave, cut off by the top of the frame, while from the left a hard white beam from a lighthouse on the island cuts straight through a fresh tear in the fog and lights a long ridge of jagged reef. A dark raiding ship lies broadside across the reef, its hull split, sail slack. Below the surface, in green-grey water lit by the beam, the fog-finned raider swims under the cracked keel, seen from the side, facing right, both hands gripping the broken timber and twisting it outward: a lean, long-waisted deep-sea demon about twenty-five to look at, sea-green skin, black hair floating loose to the collarbones, a pair of fan-shaped silver fins behind the ears, one of them torn and trailing blood into the water, pale grey-blue eyes, a dark blue cloak with old lamp-brass scraps sewn on the right breast billowing in the current. His face is calm and intent, jaw clenched with effort. Behind the stern, far away on the right, a narrow strip of dark open water glimmers like an escape lane. Far on the left, small above the water, a lone small boat with a figure holding a fish-spear sits in the torn fog. Bubbles, drifting fog and bits of broken planking blur across the corners.
falls.note: 纷争纪时段_四 第4127行，补卷_07 第432行。画的是他在船底下拧船、第二道雾墙压下来以前那一下。约恩只画成远处小船上的一个人影。

falls.how: 第八夜阿丝特丽桨往泥里一点，三十里烂泥冻成一条白路，盾阵踩着它往南边的崖脚走。南崖上的刻玛把火往谷里倒了一夜，她站在白路当中，霜跟火顶到天亮。白路只在她撑着的时候不化，盾阵最后一截还在路上，她没有停，天亮的时候谷底立着一根冰柱，桨插在冰柱里，她没有上来。
falls.name: 白路
falls.light: the last hour of night, a curtain of red fire pouring from the cliff above against the cold blue-white glow of the frozen road
falls.camera: low on the frozen road a few steps in front of her, looking up at her and the falling fire above, tilted
falls.text: Scene: the last hour before dawn at the bottom of a deep gorge cut through red earth. A road of white frost runs straight through the black mud from the near foreground into the distance toward the southern cliff, glowing cold blue. From the top of the frame, cut off by the edge, a vast curtain of crimson fire pours down from the southern cliff onto the road, and where fire meets frost the air is torn by long crossing streaks of white and red. In the middle of the road stands the woman with the oar, seen from the front at three-quarter, facing us and slightly to the right: very tall and broad-shouldered, about thirty-one, a thick pale flaxen braid coiled at the back of her head, grey-blue eyes, a white frost scar across her left brow, a padded northern coat and leather armor. Both hands grip an iron-shod rowing oar a head taller than she is, its blade planted into the ice at her feet, its shaft wound with dark worn rope. Frost is climbing up her legs and coat, her eyebrows and lashes white with rime, her face set in a fierce hard stare, burns and blood on her cheek and knuckles from the falling fire. Behind her on the left, a column of soldiers with square shields marches away from us along the frozen road, the last of them still far back in the dark. Ice crystals, embers and mud spray blur across the corners.
falls.note: 纷争纪时段_四 第3854行，补卷_68 誓尽第109行。画的是霜跟火顶着、她还站着撑桨的那一下，冰柱以前。

falls.where: 死域北沿，第十二座炮台前
falls.how: 德赫恩打完第九炮跪在炮后头不动了，屈内贡德把撤下来的炮车推上撤车的路，自己走到台前，一锤砸在瓦戈隆的膝盖上，倒下的台基翻起一道白石脊。瓦戈隆接着往前顶，她最后把锤柄往旁边一扳，叫碎石避开后头的炮车，没给自己留力，跟第十二座炮台一起叫推进了草里。
falls.name: 扳台
falls.light: autumn night on the edge of the dead lands, a dull red afterglow along a line of ruined batteries, white grass catching the light
falls.camera: from ground level behind the dwarf, looking up past her raised hammer at the giant knee filling the frame, steep tilt
falls.text: Scene: an autumn night on the northern edge of a dead land where the grass grows white and rust-colored flowers bloom on scattered iron. Filling the whole upper right of the frame and cut off by its edges is a colossal knee and shin of a giant horned demon of the thunder-hell clans, skin like dark bronze, plated with scarred armor, stepping forward over the shattered stones of a gun battery. Behind it to the left, a long line of broken battery platforms lies toppled into the grass, and a ridge of white stone is heaving up out of their rubble like a frozen waterfall. In the near foreground, small against the giant, stands the dwarf mine-smith who bent the waterfall, seen from behind at three-quarter, facing the giant knee: short and powerfully built, thick shoulders and thighs, copper-brown hair in wide braids flat against her head, heavy brows, brown eyes, a flat iron ring in her left ear, a fine dust of crystal on her nose, her tunic hem rolled up. She swings a broad-faced hammer with an iron-bound handle into the giant's knee, the impact flaring. Her breastplate is dented and blood runs from her mouth. Behind her on the left, small, a dragon-scaled gunner kneels unmoving behind a cannon, his body glowing dull red, and further back a few gun carts roll away north. Grit, white grass seeds and shards of stone blur across the corners.
falls.note: 纷争纪时段_四 第4088行，补卷_31 第163行。画的是她一锤砸在瓦戈隆膝盖上的那一下。瓦戈隆没有参考图，照轰狱深青铜的皮色用字写，只露膝和小腿。

falls.where: 死域北沿，第十二座炮台上
falls.how: 瓦戈隆一夜从西往东推炮台，德赫恩对着他打了九炮，雷顺着一座一座炮台里的魔晶往西跳，两百多里的炮台线一夜叫赤雷点亮了九回，撤车的人借着一路红光往北走。打第九炮的时候他的血烧尽了，膝盖撞在炮座上，身子从胸口往外烧透，跪在炮后头没有倒。
falls.name: 第九炮
falls.light: night lit by crimson lightning running west along a chain of crystal batteries, the gunner's own veins glowing red under his skin
falls.camera: from far to the side and slightly above the battery, the cannon and gunner on the right, the long line of batteries receding to the left, wide and tilted
falls.text: Scene: an autumn night on the northern edge of a dead land of white grass. A long line of crystal gun batteries runs away to the left toward the horizon, and a single bolt of crimson lightning leaps from one battery to the next along the whole line, every crystal flaring red, lighting a road of retreating gun carts heading north in the distance. On the left side of the frame, far down the line and cut off by the edge, a giant horned shape shoves a battery over into the grass. In the near foreground on the right, on the last battery in the line, the dragon-blooded gunner has just fired a heavy rune-carved cannon lined with old dragon bone, seen from the side, facing left along the battery line: a very tall broad-chested man who looks barely twenty, large amber scales along his forearms, shoulder-length black hair, gold-brown eyes, two short horns behind his forehead. Every blood vessel under his skin glows red, and fire spurts from between the scales on his arms. One knee has struck the gun mount and he is sinking to kneel behind the breech, both hands still on the cannon, his face pale and fierce, mouth open on a last shouted order. Below the platform a short stout dwarf woman with a hammer braces her shoulder against the stones. A few soldiers with shells crouch far behind a stone step. Sparks, red ash and white grass seeds blur across the corners.
falls.note: 纷争纪时段_四 第4049行，补卷_07 第285行。画的是第九炮刚打出去、他跪下去的那一下，从侧面远看，跟屈内贡德那一幅的机位分开。

notes: 希瑟娅的传奇之陨跟第十二张已有的节点原画“宽翼”可能是同一拍，这一幅改从下面仰看雷往上来，要不要并成一幅或写 same 请定。
希瑟娅源稿没有样子，只写翼比别的宽一半，画成逆光剪影；她的 who 没写凝名的事，页上不给年份。
刻玛的 how 照源稿是她吞得下低一档的雷、吞不下高一档的，档位字避开，写成那一炮里的雷比她吞过的都重。
琳琪什么时候知道射中的是芬妮娅源稿没给年份，放在第11张那一段。
屈内贡德和德赫恩死在同一夜同一座炮台，两幅分了机位（她正面砸膝，他侧面远看炮台线），瓦戈隆没有参考图，用字写。
拉扎尔那一幅挂了帕克图的显像，只画成远处谷里的一个高大影子。
几幅里身上的伤（琳琪肩上、戈缪肋下、刻玛脸上）是照打过的仗补的，源稿没写伤在哪一处。
阿丝特丽、杜凡、奥菲涅、刻玛、戈缪、德赫恩几位的 who 都带了名字留在哪，那多半是他们死后的事，按新添说明第6条写进去了。
